from __future__ import annotations

import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, MetaData, String, func, types
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class UtcDateTime(types.TypeDecorator):
    cache_ok = True
    impl = DateTime

    def process_bind_param(self, value, dialect):
        if value is not None:
            if isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
                if value.tzinfo is None:
                    return value
                return value.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
        return value

    def process_result_value(self, value, dialect):
        if value is not None:
            if isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
                return value.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return value


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    metadata = MetaData()
    type_annotation_map: dict[Any, Any] = {
        datetime.datetime: UtcDateTime,
        Any: types.JSON,
    }


class IdMixin:
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String, primary_key=True, default=lambda: __import__('uuid').uuid4().hex)


class TimestampMixin:
    created_at: Mapped[datetime.datetime] = mapped_column(
        UtcDateTime, nullable=False, default=lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime.datetime] = mapped_column(
        UtcDateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc),
        onupdate=lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc),
    )
